mechanism: Phenytoin induces hepatic metabolism of vitamin K-dependent clotting factors and may increase vitamin K catabolism, reducing anticoagulant efficacy in patients on warfarin or similar agents; vitamin K supplementation may reduce phenytoin levels through CYP450 induction competition.
action: Monitor INR closely if vitamin K supplementation is initiated or discontinued in patients on both phenytoin and warfarin; adjust anticoagulant dosing accordingly and monitor phenytoin levels as vitamin K may affect its metabolism.
